batch: ui (v2 real interface icon family, assets/v2/ui/gem/)
style_suffix: Material: polished engraved silver and frosted cut crystal, fine filigree engraving lines, crisp beveled facets, bright cool white-silver with a faint moonlit blue tint, soft inner glow, sharp rim light. Bold, instantly readable silhouette with rich inner detail, like a jeweller's relief for a premium dark gothic fantasy action game. Pure solid black background (#000000), nothing else in frame. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame, no surrounding circle, no ground shadow.
